totals.bySymbolAllChainsNote: Never bridge-sum: ETH is split across Arbitrum, Base and Robinhood; USDC across Arc (native), Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base and Monad. Send per chain as in bySymbolPerChain.

notes: All wallets (deployer, donatehot, agent) read 0 on every mainnet at asOf (read-only cast balance/balanceOf); Tempo eth_getBalance returns a placeholder max value, its real fee balances (pathUSD, USDC.e) are 0. So the amounts are the full send, not a top-up.

Gas units come from testnet receipts (gasUsed): ShelterSplit deploy 2.55M (Arc, Base, Avalanche), 2.61M (Arbitrum, includes L1 component), 2.76M (Robinhood), 12.67M on Tempo (budgeted 12.8M); DonateRouter deploy 1.45M (Arc, Base, Avalanche), 1.48M (Arbitrum), 1.92M (Monad); relayed gift 185-232k (Monad 333k); disburse 104-146k; Tempo disburseWithMemo 100k.
Monad bills the gas limit, not gas used: Monad lines use padded limits (split 4.4M, router 2.5M, proof 400k, treat 300k).

Tempo fees: fee in token = gasUsed x gasPrice / 1e18 USD (verified on the testnet deploy receipt: 12.67M gas at 0.6 gwei-equivalent = 0.0076 pathUSD). The 500% --gas-estimate-multiplier only raises the gas limit the balance must cover (about 5 x 12.8M x 6e8 / 1e18 = 0.04 pathUSD), so 1 pathUSD is ample.
Arc gas is native USDC (18 decimals; same balance as the 6-decimal ERC-20 at 0x3600...): Arc USDC 16 = 7.5 gas (6.2 needed with 2.5x buffer) + 1 proof + 7 treat float + 0.5 agent demo.

Token amounts are exact, unbuffered: 1 per split instance proof payout, 1 USDC.e Tempo campaign memo, 7 per chain donatehot treat float (0.01 x 100 treats/day x 7 days), 0.5 agent x402 demo on Base (USDC) and Arc (native USDC).
Treat gas budgets the full daily cap every day (700 disburse txs per chain per week); actual use is likely far lower, so the treat gas line is the main headroom.

Relay gas is budgeted for 50 relayed gifts per router chain (one day at SHELTER_RELAY_DAILY_TX=50); mainnet relay, match and x402 stay off until the shelter's per-chain wallet claim, so this is pre-funding.

Not budgeted: Token Tails 1:1 match pool (default 10 USDC per chain, 2/day) because match waits for the shelter claim; EURC treats; Base EURC split and Arbitrum EURC (chains.json has no Arbitrum mainnet EURC address; funding-plan.json eurcChains are arc and avalanche only).
Base: an extra 0.0005 ETH covers the OP-stack L1 data fee, which gasUsed does not include; Base native rounded up to 0.003 ETH.
Arbitrum and Robinhood (Orbit) gas prices are about 0.02 gwei and the receipt gasUsed already includes the L1 component; L1 price spikes are covered by the 2.5x buffer and rounding.
MON price found on CoinGecko (id monad, 0.0324 USD). USDG, USDC.e and pathUSD are valued at 1.00 USD.
Compared with funding-plan.json (mainnet): its donatehot floats cover about two days (2 tokens); these numbers cover one week (7 tokens). funding-plan.json was not edited.
